fee_notes: The initial franchise fee is $60,000 per Franchise Agreement, paid in a lump sum at signing. The fee is uniform and non-refundable under any circumstances. For franchisees signing multiple Franchise Agreements simultaneously under an Option Agreement (covering 2–10 restaurants), $60,000 is due for each agreement signed. Franchisees who signed in 2025 paid $60,000 per agreement. An initial inventory purchase of Stabilizer Base ($341–$681 estimated) is also required before opening but is a separate item.
raw_excerpt: You will pay us an initial franchise fee of $60,000 in a lump sum when you sign the Franchise Agreement. This initial franchise fee is uniform and not refundable under any circumstances. ... Franchisees who signed a Franchise Agreement with us during 2025 paid to us an initial fee (as described in this Item 5) of $60,000 for each Franchise Agreement signed.
